name: @img/sharp-wasm32
reason: sharp's WebAssembly fallback: one .wasm module with libvips, glib, libexif and libheif (LGPL-3.0) compiled in, so they are not separately replaceable. Its lock entry has no os/cpu constraint, but its only dependents are @img/sharp-freebsd-wasm32 and @img/sharp-webcontainers-wasm32, which are platform-constrained, so it is never installed on the supported hosts: Linux with glibc (ADR-0003) and macOS, the CI runners in .github/workflows/ci.yml; the licence check classes it as omitted. If a deployment ever needs it, the LGPL relinking obligation must be reviewed first. Exact-version exception.

name: @img/sharp-win32-arm64
reason: sharp's Windows build: the Apache-2.0 addon plus prebuilt libvips-42.dll (LGPL-3.0-or-later) in the same package, loaded dynamically and replaceable, unmodified, with licence and notice files preserved. name: libheif-js
reason: Software HEIC decoder (libheif + libde265 compiled to WebAssembly) required because sharp's prebuilt libvips has no HEVC decoder; approved by the maintainer for #5. The unmodified .wasm is loaded at runtime from its own node_modules package, so the operator can replace it; licence and notices are preserved and attributed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. It must stay external (not inlined) if the server is ever bundled. Exact-version exception, not general approval of LGPL dependencies.
